body_markdown:
A Porsche 918 Spyder, McLaren P1, and Ferrari LaFerrari are all up for grabs at the same auction.


Broad Arrow’s Zoute Concours Auction will present a rare gathering of the so-called Holy Trinity of 2010s hypercars.


From McLaren is a[2015 P1](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0028/2015-mclaren-p1) in MSO Storm Grey with the Stealth Pack and full Alcantara interior. The original owner clearly wanted it to fly under the radar on the rare occasions that it was driven. There are just 293 km (182 miles) on the odometer, and the car is described as being in “as new, time-warp condition.” Broad Arrow’s estimate is €1.4–€1.8 M ($1.6–$2M).


Also looking rather stealthy is a[2015 LaFerrari](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0024/2015-ferrari-laferrari) finished in Grigio Ferro Metallizzato. Its V-12 has seen considerably more use than the McLaren’s V-8, as there are 13,069 km (8121 miles) on the clock. It’s just had a new high-voltage battery fitted for the hybrid system under warranty. It’s estimated to sell for €4,000,000–€5,000,000 ($4.5–$5M).


The last of the trio is a[2015 Porsche 918 Spyder Weissach Package](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0077/2015-porsche-918-spyder-weissach-package) in an unusual Individualfarbe PTS Sport Classic Grey, a color developed for the Exclusive Manufaktur 2010 911 Sport Classic. Inside, the Leather-to-Sample interior is finished in Espresso. That Weissach Pack, meanwhile, was a €60,000 option and saved 88 lbs through the use of magnesium wheels with titanium bolts, lighter brakes, and assorted carbon fiber aero parts. It’s a car that’s been enjoyed for 18,870 km (11,727 miles), and the anticipated sales price is €2.6–€3M ($2.98–$3.45M).


Broad Arrow


Beyond the headline-grabbing hypercars are several other icons: There’s a[2005 Porsche Carrera GT,](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0062/2005-porsche-carrera-gt) a[1992 Jaguar XJ220](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0059/1992-jaguar-xj220) , a[1984 Lamborghini Countach](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0016/1984-lamborghini-countach-5000-s) , and arguably the original supercar, a[1955 Mercedes-Benz 300SL Gullwing](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0041/1955-mercedes-benz-300-sl-gullwing-coupe) . Also on sale are some true unicorns, such as the one-off[2026 Ferrari Daytona Shooting Brake Hommage,](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0029/2026-daytona-shooting-brake-hommage-by-niels-van-roij-design) a[2000 BMW M5 fitted with a W-10](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0071/2000-bmw-m5-volkswagen-w10-prototype-ex-ferdinand-piech) motor for Ferdinand Piech, and an ultra-rare[Citroën DS 21 Cabriolet](https://www.broadarrowauctions.com/vehicles/zt26_r0089/1966-citroen-ds-21-cabriolet-palm-beach-by-chapron) Palm Beach by Henri Chapron.


The sale takes place during Zoute Grand Prix Week in Belgium on October 9.
